title: HTN-Orchestrate: A Hierarchical Task Network Framework for Multi-Agent Orchestration
title_zh: HTN-Orchestrate：一种用于多智能体协同的层次化任务网络框架

paragraphs.en: Orchestrating multiple agents on a complex task requires reconciling local subtask execution with global task planning. Dynamic dispatch approaches provide execution flexibility but do not explicitly model subtask hierarchies or dependencies, while predefined workflows impose this structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins. Therefore, we introduce HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN). The Planner maintains subtask hierarchies and dependencies, deferring decomposition until prerequisite results become available, while local Orchestrators schedule workers to execute each leaf subtask. Results propagate upward under AND semantics, and accumulated findings inform a rebuilt task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness using the same base model, achieving 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 在复杂任务中协调多个智能体，需要平衡局部子任务的执行与全局任务的规划。 动态调度方法虽然提供了执行灵活性，但并未显式建模子任务的层级结构或依赖关系；而预定义的工作流虽能施加这种结构，却在执行开始前就固定了任务分解方式。 因此，我们提出了 HTN-Orchestrate——一个双层框架，通过层次化任务网络（HTN）将这两项职责分离开来。 规划器负责维护子任务的层级结构与依赖关系，并在前提条件结果可用时才开始执行任务分解；同时，局部协调器则安排执行单元完成每个叶子子任务。 在 AND 语义规则下，结果会向上层传递；当当前任务分解无法解决问题时，累积的发现将用于重建任务网络。 在涵盖网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流的五个基准测试中，HTN-Orchestrate 使用相同的基线模型便超越了 ReAct、Agent Team 和 DeepSeek Harness：它在 BrowseComp 上的准确率达到 89.73%，在 SUPERChem 上为 73.44%，分别比 Agent Team 高出 2.45 和 4.69 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on challenging reasoning tasks ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Hubert et al., 2026 ; Novikov et al., 2025 ) , and by integrating with external tools, LLM-powered agents ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Agashe et al., 2025 ) can proactively acquire information and revise actions in response to observations. Multi-agent systems ( Wu et al., 2024 ; Steinberger and OpenClaw Community, 2026 ; Nous Research, 2026 ; Anthropic, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026b ) further extend this approach by organizing agents into complementary roles that distribute investigations, explore independent approaches, and verify candidate solutions. Directing these activities toward a common goal requires orchestration ( Zhang et al., 2025c ; Ruan et al., 2026 ) , which must reconcile local subtask execution that responds to emerging findings with global task planning that maintains a structured decomposition and tracks dependencies across subtasks.

paragraphs.en: Existing approaches address orchestration through structured workflows or runtime delegation, but each sacrifices one side of this tradeoff. Structured workflows organize tasks into stages connected by explicit control flow, specifying when agents act and how they exchange results ( Hong et al., 2024 ; LangChain, 2026 ) . Whether authored manually or generated automatically as in AFlow ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) , these workflows impose clear global structure but fix the decomposition before execution begins, so that findings from local execution cannot reshape subsequent planning. Runtime delegation addresses this rigidity by having a central orchestrator determine subtasks and assign agents as execution proceeds ( Fourney et al., 2024 ; Ruan et al., 2026 ) , with agent-team approaches ( Kimi Team, 2026a ; Apodex Team, 2026 ) further extending this to parallel subagent dispatch. However, this design couples task decomposition, subtask dispatch, and result synthesis within a single orchestrator ( Ruan et al., 2026 ; Kimi Team, 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2025c ) , without explicitly modeling subtask hierarchies or precedence dependencies among sibling subtasks. Although dynamic decomposition methods such as ADaPT ( Prasad et al., 2024 ) and ReAcTree ( Choi et al., 2026 ) allow the plan to evolve during execution, they too provide limited support for representing complex dependencies, leaving the tension between adaptive local execution and structured global planning unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法通过结构化工作流程或运行时委托来处理协调问题，但每种方法都牺牲了这种权衡关系的一方面。 结构化工作流程将任务组织为通过显式控制流连接的阶段，明确智能体何时行动以及它们如何交换结果（Hong et al., 2024；LangChain, 2026）。 无论这些工作流程是手动编写，还是像 AFlow（Zhang et al., 2025b）那样自动生成，它们都施加了清晰的全局结构，但在执行开始前就固定了任务分解方式，因此局部执行的结果无法重塑后续规划。 运行时委托通过让中央协调器在执行过程中确定子任务并分配智能体来解决这种刚性（Fourney et al., 2024；Ruan et al., 2026），而智能体团队方法（Kimi Team, 2026a；Apodex Team, 2026）则进一步将其扩展到并行子智能体调度。 然而，这种设计将任务分解、子任务调度和结果合成耦合在单个协调器中（Ruan et al., 2026；Kimi Team, 2026a；Zhang et al., 2025c），并未显式建模子任务层级或同级子任务之间的先后依赖关系。 尽管像 ADaPT（Prasad et al., 2024）和 ReAcTree（Choi et al., 2026）这样的动态分解方法允许计划在执行过程中演化，但它们对表示复杂依赖关系的支持也有限，因此自适应局部执行与结构化全局规划之间的张力仍未得到解决。

paragraphs.en: We introduce HTN-Orchestrate 1 1 1 The implementation of HTN-Orchestrate is available at https://github.com/ycdeng-ntu/htn-orchestrate , a two-layer orchestration framework that separates these responsibilities through a hierarchical task network (HTN) ( Erol et al., 1994 ) . At the upper layer, the Planner expands the task network incrementally as prerequisite results become available, so that subsequent decomposition decisions reflect information obtained during execution. At the lower layer, each executable leaf subtask is delegated to an Orchestrator that schedules workers (e.g., researchers, verifiers) and uses their reports to guide investigation, verification, and synthesis. Results propagate upward through the task network under AND semantics, whereby each leaf subtask returns the result produced by its Orchestrator, while each non-leaf subtask synthesizes its result after all its children have completed. The framework also incorporates a rebuilding mechanism that constructs a new task network conditioned on partial results from the previous epoch when execution fails or there is no plausible solution under the current task network.

paragraphs.en: We combine result-informed planning, which defers decomposition decisions for dependent subtasks until prerequisite findings are available, with AND-semantic synthesis that propagates results upward through the task hierarchy, and a rebuilding mechanism that retains supported evidence from completed work to construct a revised task network when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将结果导向规划（在依赖的子任务的分解决策推迟到先决条件结果可用时再做出）与 AND-语义合成（将结果向上传播至任务层级）相结合，并引入一种重建机制：该机制保留已完成工作所支持的证据，以便在当前分解无法解决任务时构建修订后的任务网络。

In particular, HTN-Orchestrate achieves 89.73% accuracy on BrowseComp and 73.44% on SUPERChem, exceeding Agent Team by 2.45 and 4.69 percentage points, respectively. Ablations on BrowseComp demonstrate the contributions of result-informed planning, local multi-agent orchestration, and task-network rebuilding.

paragraphs.en: Multi-agent orchestration methods vary in how they distribute responsibilities between global task planning and local execution, and most designs favor one side of this tradeoff. Early frameworks such as AutoGen ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and MetaGPT ( Hong et al., 2024 ) organize collaboration through conversation patterns and role-based procedures that provide clear global structure but follow fixed interaction protocols. AFlow ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) and MaAS ( Zhang et al., 2025a ) reduce manual design effort by automating workflow and architecture construction, while Conductor ( Nielsen et al., 2026 ) and MAS-Orchestra ( Ke et al., 2026 ) learn to generate orchestration decisions through reinforcement learning. Although these methods can discover effective coordination patterns, the resulting structures are determined before or independently of task execution.

paragraphs.en: The tension between local execution and global planning is particularly evident in task decomposition, where the challenge is determining not only how to break a task apart but also when to revise that breakdown in response to execution findings. Static approaches commit to a full decomposition before observing results. Least-to-most prompting ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) generates subproblems before solving them sequentially, and Agent-Oriented Planning ( Li et al., 2025 ) accounts for agent capabilities when decomposing and allocating tasks. D-CORE ( Xu et al., 2026 ) uses reinforcement learning to incentivize decomposition reasoning in large reasoning models, and Select-Then-Decompose ( Liu et al., 2025 ) chooses a decomposition strategy according to the task. These methods improve the quality of decomposition but still finalize it before execution begins.
paragraphs.zh: 局部执行与全局规划之间的张力在任务分解中尤为明显，其挑战不仅在于如何拆分任务，还在于如何根据执行结果决定何时调整这种拆分方式。 静态方法会在观察结果之前预先完成全部任务分解。 “从少到多”提示法（Zhou 等，2023）会先生成子问题，再依次解决它们；而“智能体导向规划”（Li 等，2025）则在分解和分配任务时会考虑智能体的能力。 D-CORE（Xu 等，2026）利用强化学习来激励大型推理模型进行分解推理；而“选择-再分解”方法（Liu 等，2025）则根据具体任务选择分解策略。 这些方法虽然提升了分解的质量，但仍在执行开始前就确定了最终的分解方案。

paragraphs.en: When intermediate findings affect subsequent work, decomposition must also adapt during execution. Plan-and-Act ( Erdogan et al., 2025 ) trains models on planning trajectories and revises the plan after each executor step, ADaPT ( Prasad et al., 2024 ) recursively decomposes tasks that resist direct execution, ReCAP ( Zhang et al., 2025d ) revises the remaining plan using execution results, and ReAcTree ( Choi et al., 2026 ) organizes execution through hierarchical agent trees. TodoEvolve ( Liu et al., 2026 ) extends adaptation to the planning architecture itself by learning to generate and revise task-specific planning systems. These methods allow plans to evolve but provide limited support for explicitly modeling precedence dependencies among subtasks. HTN-Orchestrate uses prerequisite results to inform the further decomposition of dependent subtasks, deferring decisions about their internal structure until the relevant evidence becomes available.

paragraphs.en: Explicit dependencies connect global planning with local execution by determining which results must be available before subsequent work can proceed. Hierarchical task networks represent complex activities through task decomposition and constraints on the resulting subtasks ( Erol et al., 1994 ) , and recent work such as ChatHTN ( Muñoz-Avila et al., 2025 ) combines this tradition with language models by interleaving LLM-based decomposition with symbolic HTN planning. At a different level of granularity, LLMCompiler ( Kim et al., 2024 ) constructs dependencies among function calls to schedule parallel execution, whereas FlowSearch ( Hu et al., 2025b ) models research as an evolving graph of interdependent knowledge units and dynamically revises its structure in response to intermediate findings. HTN-Orchestrate distinguishes the parent-child relation that defines a decomposition from precedence dependencies among sibling subtasks. The former determines how results are synthesized upward after all children complete, while the latter determines which prerequisite results are available for further decomposition and execution. Each executable task then invokes an Orchestrator that can organize multiple workers, combining hierarchical decomposition, result-informed planning, and local multi-agent coordination within a common execution process. Table 1 summarizes the feature differences between HTN-Orchestrate and the most closely related systems.

paragraphs.en: Given a task q q and a set of worker roles and tools, HTN-Orchestrate separates global task planning from local subtask execution through two cooperating layers (Figure 1 ). At the upper layer, the Planner incrementally constructs a hierarchical task network that encodes subtask decompositions and their dependencies, while at the lower layer, each executable leaf subtask is delegated to an Orchestrator that schedules workers and returns a result. Because these results flow back to the Planner, subsequent decomposition decisions reflect findings that were unavailable when the network was first constructed, and when the current decomposition cannot resolve the task, accumulated evidence supports the construction of a revised network.
paragraphs.zh: 给定一个任务 q q 以及一组工作者角色和工具，HTN-Orchestrate 通过两个协同工作的层级（图 1）将全局任务规划与局部子任务执行分离开来。 在上层，规划器逐步构建一个层次化任务网络，该网络编码了子任务的分解及其依赖关系；而在下层，每个可执行的叶级子任务则被委托给一个协调器，由协调器安排工作者并返回结果。 由于这些结果会回流到规划器，后续的子任务分解决策便能反映在最初构建网络时无法获取的发现；而当当前的分解无法解决任务时，积累的证据将支持构建一个修订后的网络。

paragraphs.en: The Planner uses prerequisite execution results to guide subsequent task decomposition and retains accumulated findings to support replanning, as summarized in Algorithm 1 . For each ready leaf, PlanOrExecute \mathrm{PlanOrExecute} considers the original goal, the task description, its ancestors, and summaries of relevant prerequisite results, and based on this context either marks the task for direct execution or expands the network with children and their sibling dependencies. Because a dependent subtask receives its decomposition only after its prerequisites return, its internal structure can reflect their findings rather than relying on assumptions made before execution began. Depth and branching limits further control overall network growth.

paragraphs.en: When execution fails or the returned findings indicate no plausible solution under the current task network, the Planner can reconsider the decomposition through replanning. Each construction and execution of a task network constitutes an epoch , and before starting a new epoch the Planner settles or stops ongoing work and uses CollectEvidence \mathrm{CollectEvidence} to extract supported findings from completed and partial reports into an evidence summary M M . This summary conditions the construction of a new network rooted at the original task, providing planning context rather than automatically marking any new subtask as completed, so that the next epoch can pursue a different decomposition while retaining useful evidence. The number of rebuilds is bounded, and the framework terminates through one of two paths. When the root node is resolved, its synthesized result is returned directly as the final answer. When execution budgets are exhausted before the task is resolved, the framework instead synthesizes the evidence obtained so far and reports any unresolved requirements, so the output reflects the sufficiency of the evidence rather than treating the stopping condition as task success.

paragraphs.en: At each decision point, the Orchestrator considers C v C_{v} , R v R_{v} , and A v A_{v} and chooses to dispatch workers, wait for progress, or finish the subtask. A dispatch decision selects worker roles and produces task-specific instructions based on the current evidence, so an initial investigation can be followed by a focused search or a verification step when a report reveals a gap or a disputed claim. Reports are collected as workers finish, allowing the Orchestrator to schedule follow-up work while other assignments remain active, or to wait for new reports when the outstanding questions are already covered. This progressive collection of results allows local decisions to respond to evidence within a wave, while limits on concurrency, dispatch rounds, and execution time bound the work assigned to each subtask.
paragraphs.zh: 在每个决策点，协调器都会考虑 C v C_{v}、R v R_{v} 和 A v A_{v}，并选择派遣工作者、等待进展或完成子任务。 派遣决策会根据当前证据选择工作者角色并生成特定任务的指令，因此，在初步调查之后，当报告揭示出差距或有争议的声明时，可以紧接着进行针对性搜索或验证步骤。 随着工作者完成任务，报告会被收集起来，这使得协调器可以在其他任务仍在执行时安排后续工作，或者在待解决的问题已被覆盖时等待新的报告。 这种渐进式的结果收集方式使得局部决策能够响应某一波次内的证据，而对并发操作、派遣轮次和执行时间的限制则约束了分配给每个子任务的工作量。

sents.en: Reports are collected as workers finish, allowing the Orchestrator to schedule follow-up work while other assignments remain active, or to wait for new reports when the outstanding questions are already covered.
sents.zh: 随着工作者完成任务，报告会被收集起来，这使得协调器可以在其他任务仍在执行时安排后续工作，或者在待解决的问题已被覆盖时等待新的报告。

sents.en: This progressive collection of results allows local decisions to respond to evidence within a wave, while limits on concurrency, dispatch rounds, and execution time bound the work assigned to each subtask.
sents.zh: 这种渐进式的结果收集方式使得局部决策能够响应某一波次内的证据，而对并发操作、派遣轮次和执行时间的限制则约束了分配给每个子任务的工作量。

paragraphs.en: Once the Orchestrator decides to finish, it stops work that is no longer needed and synthesizes the collected reports into a leaf result that includes a summary, a resolved or unresolved outcome, and evidence references. If an execution limit is reached before a voluntary finish, the Orchestrator collects available reports within the remaining time and returns the supported findings together with any outstanding gaps. In both cases, the outcome reflects the sufficiency of the evidence rather than merely whether workers stopped or a verifier was invoked, and the Planner uses the returned result to inform subsequent decomposition through PlanOrExecute \mathrm{PlanOrExecute} and parent synthesis through PropagateResults \mathrm{PropagateResults} .
paragraphs.zh: 一旦协调器决定结束，它就会停止不再需要的工作，并将收集到的报告综合成一个最终结果，该结果包括摘要、已解决或未解决的结论以及证据参考。 如果在主动结束之前达到了执行限制，协调器将在剩余时间内收集可用的报告，并返回已支持的发现以及任何尚未填补的空白。 在这两种情况下，结果都反映了证据的充分性，而不仅仅是工作者是否停止或验证器是否被调用；规划器则利用返回的结果，通过 PlanOrExecute \mathrm{PlanOrExecute} 指导后续的分解，并通过 PropagateResults \mathrm{PropagateResults} 指导父级综合。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate HTN-Orchestrate on five benchmarks covering web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows. BrowseComp (BC) ( Wei et al., 2025 ) tests an agent’s ability to locate hard-to-find information through persistent web browsing. For scientific reasoning and research, we use both tracks of FrontierScience ( Wang et al., 2026 ) , with FrontierScience-Research (FSR) comprising open-ended research subproblems and FrontierScience-Olympiad (FSO) assessing olympiad-level reasoning in physics, chemistry, and biology. We use the text-only subset of 256 questions from SUPERChem ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) to further evaluate multistep reasoning across chemistry subfields, while PRL-Bench ( Miao et al., 2026 ) extends the evaluation to theoretical and computational physics research tasks derived from published papers. We report accuracy for BC, FSO, and SUPERChem, where answers can be directly verified against ground truth. For the rubric-based benchmarks, we report the success rate for FSR, defined as the fraction of responses earning at least seven of ten rubric points, and the mean percentage of satisfied rubric criteria on a 0–100 scale for PRL-Bench.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五个基准测试上评估了 HTN-Orchestrate，这些测试涵盖了网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流程。 BrowseComp (BC)（Wei 等人，2025）测试智能体通过持续的网络浏览定位难以查找信息的能力。 在科学推理和研究方面，我们使用了 FrontierScience（Wang 等人，2026）的两个分支：FrontierScience-Research（FSR）包含开放式的研究子问题，而 FrontierScience-Olympiad（FSO）则评估物理、化学和生物学科奥林匹克竞赛水平的推理能力。 我们使用 SUPERChem（Zhao 等人，2025）中仅包含文本的 256 个问题子集，进一步评估跨化学各子领域的多步推理能力；同时，PRL-Bench（Miao 等人，2026）将评估范围扩展到了源自已发表论文的理论物理和计算物理研究任务。 我们对 BC、FSO 和 SUPERChem 报告了准确率，因为这些任务的回答可以直接与标准答案进行验证。 对于基于评分标准的基准测试，我们报告了 FSR 的成功率（定义为获得至少七分评分标准分数的回答比例），以及 PRL-Bench 在 0–100 量表上满足评分标准项的平均百分比。

paragraphs.en: All four methods use DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash as the backbone model with high reasoning effort. In HTN-Orchestrate, workers instead use low reasoning effort and operate in two complementary roles for research and verification. Their available tools include web search, webpage retrieval, scholarly search, Python execution, file reading, and report submission, though search and retrieval are disabled for FSR, FSO, SUPERChem, and PRL-Bench. To bound network growth and execution cost, we set the maximum task-network depth to two (counting the root at depth zero) with at most four children per node, and within each executable subtask allow up to three concurrent workers over at most twelve orchestration rounds per epoch, while the Planner can rebuild the task network once during execution. Appendix A lists the full execution settings, evaluation judges, and measurement definitions.

paragraphs.en: HTN-Orchestrate outperforms all three controlled baselines on every benchmark and is competitive with frontier proprietary models despite using DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, an open-weight model, as its backbone (Table 2 ). On BrowseComp, it achieves 89.73% accuracy, exceeding ReAct by 15.80 percentage points and Agent Team by 2.45 points. Only GPT-6 Astra (91.50%), Kimi K3 (91.20%), and GPT-5.6 Sol (90.40%) score higher, all of which are frontier-scale models. Agent Team, which dispatches subagents without hierarchical planning, already exceeds ReAct by 13.35 points, confirming that multi-agent execution is broadly beneficial for persistent web research. The additional 2.45-point gain from HTN-Orchestrate over Agent Team reflects the contribution of structured decomposition and result-informed planning.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有基准测试中，HTN-Orchestrate 的表现均优于三种受控基线模型，并且尽管其骨干模型是开源权重模型 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash，其性能仍能与前沿专有模型相媲美（表 2）。 在 BrowseComp 测试中，其准确率达到 89.73%，比 ReAct 高出 15.80 个百分点，比 Agent Team 高出 2.45 个百分点。 只有 GPT-6 Astra（91.50%）、Kimi K3（91.20%）和 GPT-5.6 Sol（90.40%）的得分更高，而这些模型均为前沿规模的模型。 Agent Team 无需层级规划即可派遣子智能体，其表现已比 ReAct 高出 13.35 个百分点，这证实了多智能体执行方式对持续性网络研究具有广泛益处。 HTN-Orchestrate 相比 Agent Team 额外提升的 2.45 个百分点，体现了结构化分解与结果导向规划所带来的贡献。

paragraphs.en: To understand how HTN-Orchestrate’s two-layer design translates accuracy gains into distinct execution patterns, and to isolate the contribution of each architectural component, we conduct execution analysis and ablation studies on a 200-question subset randomly sampled from BrowseComp. paragraphs.en: Execution Analysis. The per-question comparisons in Figure 2 reveal how HTN-Orchestrate’s accuracy advantage interacts with completion time. Among the 165 questions both HTN-Orchestrate and Agent Team answer correctly, HTN-Orchestrate finishes faster on 112 (67.9%), with a median per-question completion-time ratio of 0.699 relative to Agent Team, so its time advantage complements its higher overall accuracy. The comparison with ReAct reveals a different tradeoff, as HTN-Orchestrate generally takes longer on questions both methods answer correctly while correctly answering 38 questions that ReAct misses and missing only 12 that ReAct answers correctly, for a net gain of 26 correct answers.

paragraphs.en: To characterize parallel execution, we apply the average-concurrency measure used in performance analysis ( Huang et al., 2010 ) to worker invocations. For each question, average worker concurrency is C ¯ = 1 T ​ ∑ i d i \bar{C}=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{i}d_{i} , where d i d_{i} is the active duration of worker invocation i i within the trace window and T T is the question’s makespan, giving the time-weighted mean number of active workers over the full window including periods with no active workers. Figure 3 compares this measure and the fraction of time spent at different worker counts. Averaged across all questions, worker concurrency is 2.47 for HTN-Orchestrate and 1.70 for Agent Team; on the 165 shared successes, it remains higher at 2.42 vs. 1.82. On this shared subset, HTN-Orchestrate spends an average of 24.6% of each run with at least four active workers, compared with 11.8% for Agent Team, but it also spends a larger fraction of time with no active workers, during which planning, coordination, or synthesis can still proceed. This pattern of concentrated worker activity interspersed with non-worker periods is consistent with its hierarchical organization, which dispatches workers concurrently across executable subtasks, and accompanies the shorter completion times observed on shared successes.

paragraphs.en: We presented HTN-Orchestrate, a two-layer orchestration framework that separates global task planning from local multi-agent execution. Its upper layer maintains a hierarchical task network that decomposes incrementally as prerequisite findings become available and can be rebuilt when the initial plan proves insufficient, while its lower layer coordinates multiple workers within each executable subtask. On five benchmarks spanning web research, scientific reasoning, and research workflows, HTN-Orchestrate consistently outperforms ReAct, Agent Team, and DeepSeek Harness. Ablation studies on BrowseComp suggest that result-informed planning, local multi-agent orchestration, and task-network rebuilding each contribute to this advantage, with execution traces revealing interdependence between the two layers. These findings show that separating control across two layers while feeding results back through a shared, revisable task structure allows each layer to inform the other and strengthens both. Future work includes scaling the task-network depth for problems that require deeper decomposition hierarchies and evaluating the framework across additional backbone models.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 HTN-Orchestrate，这是一个双层编排框架，它将全局任务规划与局部多智能体执行分离开来。 其上层维护一个分层任务网络，该网络会随着前提条件的发现而逐步分解，并在初始计划证明不足时能够重建；同时，其下层则协调每个可执行子任务内的多个执行者。 在涵盖网络研究、科学推理和研究工作流的五个基准测试中，HTN-Orchestrate 的表现始终优于 ReAct、Agent Team 和 DeepSeek Harness。 在 BrowseComp 上的消融研究表明，基于结果的规划、局部多智能体编排以及任务网络的重建各自都对这一优势有所贡献，而执行轨迹则揭示了这两层之间的相互依赖关系。 这些发现表明，通过将控制权分离到两个层级，并通过共享且可修订的任务结构反馈结果，可以使每一层为另一层提供信息，从而增强两者的能力。 未来的工作包括为需要更深层分解层次的问题扩展任务网络的深度，并在更多基础模型上评估该框架的性能。

paragraphs.en: Choose exactly one planning action: - execute_direct when the remaining work is one coherent investigation, verification, or synthesis that the adaptive leaf orchestrator can handle. - decompose only when two or more genuinely distinct workstreams benefit from separate execution, parallelism, timeout isolation, or later hierarchical synthesis.

paragraphs.en: The core decision rule from the system prompt:
paragraphs.zh: 来自系统提示的核心决策规则：

paragraphs.en: dispatch -- Send agents when R does not yet fully + verifiably answer the leaf task. Pursue important routes through genuinely different retrieval methods. Verify BEFORE finishing: once you have a candidate, dispatch a verifier so it re-confirms with independent searches. wait -- Use when R is not sufficient to terminate, at least one agent is still in flight, and R exposes no distinct gap worth dispatching. terminate -- When R contains a complete answer AND a verifier has confirmed it, OR when no distinct evidence-producing route remains. Retain the best-supported candidate and explicit unresolved gaps.
paragraphs.zh: 派遣——当 R 尚未完全且可验证地回答叶任务时，派遣智能体。 通过真正不同的检索方法，探索重要路线。 在完成前进行验证：一旦获得候选答案，就派遣一个验证器，使其通过独立搜索重新确认。等待——当 R 不足以终止、至少有一个智能体仍在途中，且 R 未暴露出值得派遣的明显缺口时使用。终止——当 R 包含完整答案且已有验证器确认该答案，或者当不存在任何能产生明确证据的路线时。 保留支持度最高的候选答案以及明确未解决的缺口。

paragraphs.en: Separate templates cover leaf, internal-node, and root synthesis. Leaf synthesis joins worker reports into an evidence memo. Internal synthesis combines child results for the parent. All templates distinguish resolved (the complete answer-bearing claim is positively supported) from exhausted_unresolved (a decisive relation remains missing after available routes are exhausted, with partial evidence preserved).

paragraphs.en: When the current task network cannot resolve the root objective, the recovery step extracts supported facts through an extract_supported_facts tool that requires each claim to include a verbatim supporting quote and source reference. These facts, together with unresolved relations and the reason the previous approach stopped, form the restart context for the next epoch. The rebuild instructions supplement the Planner with the requirement to identify the most discriminative unresolved relation and to preserve a discovery route that can surface an alternative candidate.
paragraphs.zh: 当当前任务网络无法解决根本目标时，恢复步骤会通过一个 extract_supported_facts 工具提取支持性事实，该工具要求每个主张都必须包含逐字引用的支持性引文和来源参考。 这些事实，连同未解决的关系以及先前方法停止的原因，共同构成了下一轮重启的上下文。 重建指令为规划器补充了要求：必须识别最具区分性的未解决关系，并保留一条能够揭示替代候选项的发现路径。

sents.zh: 每种方法都仅改变编排流程的一个部分，同时保留其余机制不变。

paragraphs.en: In the single-agent variant, the unit of assignment is an executed leaf within an epoch. A question may still contain several leaves, and a rebuilt task network may introduce new leaves. In the upfront variant, a downstream worker can consume completed prerequisite results even though its position and objective were planned earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 在单智能体变体中，分配的基本单位是一个周期内执行过的叶节点。 一个问题可能仍然包含多个叶节点，而重建的任务网络可能会引入新的叶节点。 在预先规划变体中，下游工作者即使其位置和目标是提前规划的，也可以使用已完成的前置结果。

paragraphs.en: BrowseComp Q193 asks for a radio station’s first broadcast year through a chain of clues involving a 1993 role-playing supplement, one of its authors, a children’s book, and the author’s father. The initial investigation identifies Creative Campaigning and returns four authors: Tony Pryor, Tony Herring, Jonathan Tweet, and Norm Ritchie. The Planner then specializes the downstream investigation using this returned list, checking which author wrote the 2015 children’s book and establishing the father’s identity.
paragraphs.zh: BrowseComp Q193 通过一系列线索询问一个广播电台的首次广播年份，这些线索涉及一份 1993 年的角色扮演补充材料、其作者之一、一本儿童读物以及该作者的父亲。 初步调查锁定了《Creative Campaigning》，并得出了四位作者：Tony Pryor、Tony Herring、Jonathan Tweet 和 Norm Ritchie。 随后，规划器利用这份名单对后续调查进行细化，检查哪位作者撰写了 2015 年的那本儿童读物，并确定其父亲的身份。

sents.zh: BrowseComp Q193 通过一系列线索询问一个广播电台的首次广播年份，这些线索涉及一份 1993 年的角色扮演补充材料、其作者之一、一本儿童读物以及该作者的父亲。

sents.en: The Planner then specializes the downstream investigation using this returned list, checking which author wrote the 2015 children’s book and establishing the father’s identity.
sents.zh: 随后，规划器利用这份名单对后续调查进行细化，检查哪位作者撰写了 2015 年的那本儿童读物，并确定其父亲的身份。

paragraphs.en: The resulting chain identifies Jonathan Tweet, Grandmother Fish , Roald Tweet, and WVIK, leading to the answer 1980 . The upfront variant also answers correctly, but plans its children’s-book investigation before receiving the author list. Across the complete attempts, HTN-Orchestrate executes four leaves and 15 workers, compared with five leaves and 20 workers for upfront decomposition. This case shows how an intermediate result can make the remaining task more specific even when both methods eventually reach the same answer.
paragraphs.zh: 由此产生的链识别出了 Jonathan Tweet、Grandmother Fish、Roald Tweet 和 WVIK，最终得出答案 1980。 前置变体也能正确作答，但它在收到作者列表之前就已经规划了对儿童读物的调查。 在所有尝试中，HTN-Orchestrate 执行了四个叶节点和 15 个工作者，而前置分解则执行了五个叶节点和 20 个工作者。 这个案例表明，即使两种方法最终都得出相同的答案，中间结果也能使剩余任务变得更加具体。

paragraphs.en: BrowseComp Q1025 asks for a conductor identified by a 2008 concert review, a poem-based opening work, and a venue dedicated in the early 1990s. The task network separates identifying the poem, locating candidate reviews, and reconciling the conductor’s identity. Within the review-search leaf, the Orchestrator dispatches complementary review-first, venue-first, and opening-song investigations.
paragraphs.zh: BrowseComp Q1025 要求根据一篇 2008 年的音乐会评论、一首以诗歌为基础的开篇作品，以及一个于 20 世纪 90 年代初专门设立的演出场所，来确定一位指挥家。 该任务网络将识别诗歌、定位候选评论以及确认指挥家身份这三个步骤分离开来。 在评论搜索叶节点中，Orchestrator 会分别启动以评论为先、以场所为先以及以开篇曲目为先的互补性调查。

sents.en: BrowseComp Q1025 asks for a conductor identified by a 2008 concert review, a poem-based opening work, and a venue dedicated in the early 1990s.
sents.zh: BrowseComp Q1025 要求根据一篇 2008 年的音乐会评论、一首以诗歌为基础的开篇作品，以及一个于 20 世纪 90 年代初专门设立的演出场所，来确定一位指挥家。

sents.zh: 该任务网络将识别诗歌、定位候选评论以及确认指挥家身份这三个步骤分离开来。

paragraphs.en: The venue-first report connects the Berger Center, dedicated in 1992, with Reveille Men’s Chorus, conductor Linus Lerner , and the opener Come Travel With Me . The Orchestrator then assigns a verifier to check that evidence chain. The completed attempt uses three leaves and ten workers. The single-agent-per-leaf variant executes nine leaves across two epochs and submits Gregory Wait ; its final explanation does not establish the specific 2008 review connecting that conductor to the requested performance.
paragraphs.zh: 首场演出报告将 1992 年成立的 Berger 中心、指挥 Linus Lerner 的 Reveille 男子合唱团以及开场曲目《Come Travel With Me》联系了起来。 随后，编排者会指派一个验证者来检查这条证据链。 完成的尝试使用了三片叶子和十名工作者。 每个叶子仅由单个智能体执行的变体在两个周期内执行了九片叶子，并提交了 Gregory Wait；其最终解释并未明确说明将这位指挥与所请求的演出联系起来的特定 2008 年评审信息。

paragraphs.en: BrowseComp Q501 asks for the third song in a 24-song blog list dated 27 December, using clues about a weekly feature and an album. In the first epoch, the investigation fails to recover the required list before a leaf timeout. Recovery retains the findings and unresolved source-identification work, and the next epoch constructs a revised task network.
paragraphs.zh: BrowseComp Q501 要求从一份日期为 12 月 27 日的包含 24 首歌曲的博客歌单中找出第三首歌，并提供了关于每周特辑和一张专辑的线索。 在第一轮中，调查未能在一轮超时前恢复出所需的歌单。 恢复过程保留了已发现的成果以及尚未解决的来源识别工作，下一轮则会构建一个修订后的任务网络。

sents.en: In the first epoch, the investigation fails to recover the required list before a leaf timeout.
sents.zh: 在第一轮中，调查未能在一轮超时前恢复出所需的歌单。

paragraphs.en: The second epoch obtains answer-bearing evidence in its post-list branch. When a later timeout ends further execution, recovery finalization uses the accumulated evidence to return “Serial Killer” by Tobin Sprout . The no-rebuilding variant returns “Silent Night.” The full attempt executes five leaves and 72 workers across two epochs, compared with two leaves and 18 workers for no rebuilding. This case illustrates a successful continuation through evidence-preserving recovery, including finalization from the evidence available at the execution limit.
paragraphs.zh: 第二个周期在其后列表分支中获得了包含答案的证据。 当后续超时结束进一步执行时，恢复最终化会使用累积的证据返回托宾·斯普劳特的《连环杀手》。 无重建版本返回《静夜》。完整尝试在两个周期内执行了五个叶节点和 72 个工作者，而无重建版本仅执行了两个叶节点和 18 个工作者。 此案例展示了通过保留证据的恢复实现的成功延续，包括在执行极限时利用可用证据进行最终化。
